Title: Q Orgy of Blood and The grandest Trick

Messages.Author: Sten During
Messages.Body:
If the acting vampire (having played The grandest Trick) meets an
untimely demise, what happens when the blocking ally plays Orgy
of Blood?

1) Each vampire gains zero blood.
2) Each vampire gains the printed capacity of the acting vamp in blood.
3) Each vampire gains the actings vamps current capacity in blood.

Sten During
